facts.fact: CIPESA says mobile data was blocked nationwide in Senegal in early February 2024 after the presidential election was postponed, the country's third disruption in under 12 months.
CIPESA reports that the ECOWAS Court of Justice ruled on 14 May 2025 that Senegal's internet and social media shutdowns of June and July 2023 violated fundamental rights.
facts.system: ECOWAS Court judgment, ASUTIC and Ndiaga Gueye v. Senegal
